fallback: C, conditional on A/B capability failure and real skilled capacity; if A wins fair pilot, keep A instead
ranking_limits: Ordinal decision judgments, not probabilities or measured market outcomes. C visual ceiling assumes capable humans; D unknown is not proof intrinsically worse. No invented chance percentages.

strategies.name: Refine latest hybrid
strategies.retain: Ember canon, current full-frame renderer, most compatible plates, SVG/state/hashes
strategies.replace: Wrong-beat plates, defective lettering, acceptance logic; selective grading/pacing
strategies.discard: Preset superiority claims and unsupported source bindings
strategies.quality_ceiling: Useful visible gains plausible; sustained premium sequence ceiling unproven
strategies.owner_fit: Moderate, supported by pilot enthusiasm but weakened by repeated dissatisfaction
unknowns: How many existing plates need replacement
Whether targeted repair fixes acting cheaply
strategies.pilot: Best current renderer on same frozen14-beat sequence; no reuse unless exact beat is met
strategies.roles: Editor/action reviewer, art selector/repairer, letterer, production engineer
strategies.tooling: Keep current generator; add actual annotation and rendered-glyph review
strategies.iteration: One selection/repair cycle after storyboard review
strategies.spend: $0 incremental during this audit; future external labor/cloud unpriced and unauthorized
strategies.risks: Retained fused plates limit edits; temptation to repeat late-stage cosmetic fixes
strategies.reversibility: High: replace selected revisions without changing canon
strategies.leading_indicators: Zero wrong-beat bindings; readable exchange; actual owner preference
strategies.kill: One allowed repair cannot resolve essential action/state/lettering failures, or sequence remains unpreferred
strategies.scale: All shared pilot gates pass and actual correction hours fit ceiling
strategies.opportunity_cost: Could consume another cycle preserving unsuitable imagery

strategies.name: Modular replacement with storyboard-led source selection
strategies.retain: Provisional Ember world/cast/progression, valid IDs/hashes/state/nullable records, editable SVG and readers
strategies.replace: Late mapping of finished plates with approved thumbnails and source-to-beat contracts; comparison route adds separable character/background/line/effect finishing
strategies.discard: Requirement to reuse current imagery; synthetic quality/protection/scenario evidence
strategies.quality_ceiling: Highest useful next uncertainty reduction; premium capability plausible but unproven
strategies.owner_fit: Best current decision fit: respects approved premise while addressing demonstrated stage failures
evidence: Exact incompatible source prompts for5 cases
Current architecture permits new raster/layer sources
unknowns: Benefit/cost of separable clean shapes and manual corrections
strategies.pilot: Two routes on frozen14 beats: best-current directed baseline versus materially different controlled-layer route; optional human-first third only if staffed
strategies.roles: Story/action editor, storyboard/character artist, finishing artist or skilled equivalent, letterer, two independent human readers
strategies.tooling: Editable thumbnails/model sheets; layout-conditioned asset/layer intake; semantic acceptance before rendering/lettering
strategies.iteration: Freeze → rough correction → one candidate → at most one hard-failure retry → bounded finishing → blind sequence review
strategies.spend: $0 audit; if skilled human time is unavailable, stop at plan/rough proof; no purchase implied
strategies.risks: Can become an expensive hidden C rebuild; cleaner finish alone may not appeal
strategies.rights: Keep only assets with documented permitted use; no current route declared commercially cleared
strategies.reversibility: High: current sources and story remain intact, routes share manifests
strategies.leading_indicators: Correct event art, increased attention hierarchy, easier specific edits, preferred complete reader
strategies.kill: No decisive preference or unacceptable correction burden after frozen attempts; no extra beauty loop

strategies.replace: Creative production spine with conventional thumbnails/model sheets/layout/line/color/finishing and accountable human approval
strategies.discard: Automation as default owner of artistic acceptance; fused full-frame generation where it obstructs edits
strategies.quality_ceiling: Potentially highest with capable artists and editorial direction; not demonstrated here
strategies.owner_fit: Promising long-term fit if staffed; uncertain practical availability
unknowns: Whether AI adds any verified advantage
strategies.pilot: Same14 beats with human-first layouts and corrections; generation only for isolated advantageous tasks
strategies.roles: Experienced sequential artist/action director, color/finish, letterer/editor, reviewers
strategies.tooling: Conventional layered art tools; simple3D if useful; generation optional

strategies.name: Greenfield story and visual restart
strategies.retain: Only proven engineering lessons and safety/provenance practices
strategies.replace: Premise/cast/art direction/production topology via new original pilot
strategies.discard: Obligation to preserve Ember canon or source art
strategies.quality_ceiling: Unbounded in principle, no evidence of a better realized ceiling
strategies.owner_fit: Unknown; current dissatisfaction does not establish rejection of premise

strategies.tooling: No speculative new stack before approved roughs
